frr:
frr defaults traditional
no zebra nexthop kernel enable

!

ip prefix-list OUT4 seq 10 permit 10.71.0.0/16
ip prefix-list OUT4 seq 20 permit 192.0.2.0/24
ip prefix-list OUT4 seq 30 permit 10.71.255.1/32
ip prefix-list IN4 seq 5 deny 10.253.0.0/16 le 32
ip prefix-list IN4 seq 10 deny 10.71.0.0/16 le 32
ip prefix-list IN4 seq 20 deny 192.0.2.0/24 le 32
ip prefix-list IN4 seq 30 deny 10.71.255.1/32 le 32
ip prefix-list IN4 seq 1010 permit 10.0.0.0/8 le 32
ipv6 prefix-list OUT6 seq 10 permit fd71:0:0:1::/64
ipv6 prefix-list IN6 seq 10 deny fd71:0:0:1::/64 le 128
ipv6 prefix-list IN6 seq 1010 permit fc00::/7 le 128
ipv6 prefix-list IN6 seq 1020 permit 2001:678:dc0::/48 le 128
!

route-map PEER-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list IN4
exit
route-map PEER-OUT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list OUT4
exit
route-map MESH-OUT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list OUT4
exit
route-map PEER-IN6 permit 10
 match ipv6 address prefix-list IN6
exit
route-map PEER-OUT6 permit 10
 match ipv6 address prefix-list OUT6
exit
route-map MESH-OUT6 permit 10
 match ipv6 address prefix-list OUT6
exit
!
route-map SRC4 permit 10
 set src 10.71.0.1
exit
ip protocol bgp route-map SRC4
!
vrf mesh
 vni 50001
exit-vrf
!
router bgp 64500
 bgp router-id 10.71.0.1
 no bgp default ipv4-unicast
 
 neighbor 10.253.0.1 remote-as internal
 neighbor 10.253.0.1 description hub-evpn
 neighbor 10.253.0.1 update-source wt0
 neighbor 10.253.0.1 timers 10 30
 neighbor 10.253.0.1 timers connect 10
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.71.0.0/16
  network 192.0.2.0/24
  network 10.71.255.1/32
  
  import vrf mesh
  import vrf route-map PEER-IN
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  network fd71:0:0:1::/64
  
  import vrf mesh
  import vrf route-map PEER-IN6
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family l2vpn evpn
  neighbor 10.253.0.1 activate
  advertise-all-vni
 exit-address-family
exit
!
router bgp 64500 vrf mesh
 bgp router-id 10.71.0.1
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  import vrf default
  import vrf route-map MESH-OUT
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  import vrf default
  import vrf route-map MESH-OUT6
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family l2vpn evpn
  advertise ipv4 unicast
  advertise ipv6 unicast
 exit-address-family
exit

MACAddress=02:5e:0a:47:00:01
MTUBytes=1370

[Bridge]

STP=false

nft.router:
inet
set trusted4 { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; elements = { 10.0.0.0/8 } }
set trusted6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; elements = { fc00::/7, 2001:678:dc0::/48 } }



chain input {
  type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
  ct state vmap { established : accept, related : accept, invalid : drop }
  iifname "lo" accept
  # Echo from the WAN is limited per source; every other ICMP type stays open
  # (neighbor discovery, router advertisements, path MTU discovery).
  iifname "wan0" icmp type echo-request meter icmp_echo4 { ip saddr limit rate over 10/second } drop
  iifname "wan0" icmpv6 type echo-request meter icmp_echo6 { ip6 saddr limit rate over 10/second } drop
  ip protocol icmp accept
  ip6 nexthdr icmpv6 accept

  # Services (router.firewall.services)
  # dhcp: udp { 67, 547 } from lan
  iifname "lan0" udp dport { 67, 547 } accept
  # dns: both { 53 } from lan, mesh, trusted
  iifname "lan0" meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 53 } accept
  iifname { "br50001", "mesh" } meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 53 } accept
  ip saddr @trusted4 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 53 } accept
  ip6 saddr @trusted6 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 53 } accept
  # dns-ui: tcp { 3000 } from lan, trusted
  iifname "lan0" tcp dport { 3000 } accept
  ip saddr @trusted4 tcp dport { 3000 } accept
  ip6 saddr @trusted6 tcp dport { 3000 } accept
  # ntp: udp { 123 } from lan
  iifname "lan0" udp dport { 123 } accept
  # ssh: tcp { 22 } from lan, trusted
  iifname "lan0" tcp dport { 22 } accept
  ip saddr @trusted4 tcp dport { 22 } accept
  ip6 saddr @trusted6 tcp dport { 22 } accept

  # Infrastructure (generated from the features)
  
  # NetBird underlay: WireGuard from anywhere but the mesh (no tunnel through itself)
iifname != { "br50001", "mesh" } udp dport 51820 accept

  # BGP only from the configured neighbours
  
  
  
  
  # EVPN: VXLAN only through the overlay, from its range (with enforcePolicies NetBird's
# policies decide first). BGP to the hub is our outgoing session (the hub only listens).
iifname "wt0" ip saddr 10.253.0.0/16 udp dport 4789 accept

  
  iifname "wan0" limit rate 5/second burst 20 packets log prefix "nft-drop-in: " level info
}

# Reply-to (routes: networking.nix): connections arriving on the WAN get a ct mark bit,
# their packets from elsewhere (LAN replies, our own) the packet mark -> WAN table.
chain wan_reply_pre {
  type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
  iifname "wan0" ct state new ct mark set ct mark or 0x10000000
  iifname != "wan0" ct mark and 0x10000000 == 0x10000000 meta mark set meta mark or 0x10000000
}
chain wan_reply_out {
  type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept;
  ct mark and 0x10000000 == 0x10000000 meta mark set meta mark or 0x10000000
}

# NetBird underlay never into the mesh: a path check to an address the mesh routes (a
# peer's LAN or client-NAT address) succeeds over the overlay, and the overlay would
# then carry itself (a loop). The input chain refuses the other direction.
chain output {
  type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
  oifname { "br50001", "mesh" } udp sport 51820 drop
}


chain forward {
  type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
  # Hairpin: a host on the LAN reaching a network routed via another LAN host (e.g. a
  # cluster's addresses). That host answers the client directly (same L2), so the router
  # sees one direction only and conntrack would drop the client's ACKs as invalid.
  iifname "lan0" oifname "lan0" accept
  ct state vmap { established : accept, related : accept, invalid : drop }
  ip protocol icmp accept
  ip6 nexthdr icmpv6 accept

  iifname "lan0" accept                       # lan -> anywhere
  # TCP MSS follows the path MTU of the mesh (VXLAN 1370 < 1500), both directions
oifname { "br50001", "mesh" } tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu
iifname { "br50001", "mesh" } oifname "lan0" accept  # mesh -> lan (spoke: no transit)

  iifname { "br50001", "mesh" } oifname "wan0" ip daddr 192.0.2.0/24 accept  # mesh -> announced WAN net

  
  ct status dnat accept                           # port forwards
  iifname "wan0" oifname "lan0" ip saddr @trusted4 accept
iifname "wan0" oifname "lan0" ip6 saddr @trusted6 accept

  
  iifname "wan0" limit rate 5/second burst 20 packets log prefix "nft-drop-fwd: " level info
}

secretsActivation:
install -d -m 0711 -o root -g root /var/lib/secrets
if [ ! -s /var/lib/secrets/adguard-password-hash ]; then
  echo "router-secrets: /var/lib/secrets/adguard-password-hash is missing or empty (deliver it: ./router push-secrets <site>)" >&2
  false
else
  [ "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /var/lib/secrets/adguard-password-hash)" = "root:root:400" ] \
  || { chown root:root /var/lib/secrets/adguard-password-hash && chmod 0400 /var/lib/secrets/adguard-password-hash; }

fi

if [ ! -s /var/lib/secrets/netbird-setup-key ]; then
  echo "router-secrets: /var/lib/secrets/netbird-setup-key is missing or empty (deliver it: ./router push-secrets <site>)" >&2
  false
else
  [ "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /var/lib/secrets/netbird-setup-key)" = "root:root:400" ] \
  || { chown root:root /var/lib/secrets/netbird-setup-key && chmod 0400 /var/lib/secrets/netbird-setup-key; }

fi

if [ ! -s /var/lib/secrets/ssh-host-key ]; then
  echo "router-secrets: /var/lib/secrets/ssh-host-key is missing or empty (deliver it: ./router push-secrets <site>)" >&2
  false
else
  [ "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /var/lib/secrets/ssh-host-key)" = "root:root:400" ] \
  || { chown root:root /var/lib/secrets/ssh-host-key && chmod 0400 /var/lib/secrets/ssh-host-key; }

fi
